description: Default edge values applied when an edge stencil creates or updates a diagram edge.

members.name: ArcSize
members.description: Corner radius in pixels for rounded edges.

members.name: ConnectorType
members.description: Connector semantic type. Supported values match ConnectorType.

members.name: CubicBezier
members.description: Whether curved routing uses cubic Bezier commands.

members.name: EndArrow
members.description: End arrowhead style. Supported values match EndArrow.

members.name: EndArrowFill
members.description: Whether the end arrowhead is filled. Null uses the renderer default.

members.name: Rounded
members.description: Whether to use rounded corners on the edge path.

members.name: Routing
members.description: Edge routing type. Supported values match Routing.

members.name: Shape
members.description: Edge shape type. Supported values match Shape.

members.name: StartArrow
members.description: Start arrowhead style. Supported values match StartArrow.

members.name: StartArrowFill
members.description: Whether the start arrowhead is filled. Null uses the renderer default.

members.name: Style
members.description: Optional default visual style for edges created from this stencil.
